candidates.title: [Bug]: GDN chunk/prefill path overflows fp16 with a large fp32 SSM state (chunk-path follow-up to #54146)
candidates.snippet: ## Overview  Anyone running a GDN model (e.g. Qwen3-Next/3.5) with `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype float32` (the setting meant to prevent exactly this problem) can still hit an fp16 overflow during prefill/chunked processing, not just decode. `chunk_gated_delta_rule` (the GDN chunk/prefill path) produces inf/NaN output and a corrupted recurrent state once that state grows large over a long prompt, the same decode-collapse symptom #54146/#54308 describe, but triggered from the prefill side instead.
